anchor: Transport returns bounded raw response bytes and usage to the guided parser;
addition:
**Accepted static schema epoch (STUDIO-OBS-007).** One `GuidedPromptAssembler` instance owns a complete startup snapshot of the approved output contract, required static schema inputs, all three current provider schemas and their existing provenance hashes. Construction finishes the original reference expansion, shape compaction and hash algorithms before publishing the instance. Missing, malformed, unsupported-reference or canonicalization failures fail construction/startup, including the unconditional bean and retained standalone constructors; no partial snapshot or fallback is published. This deliberately replaces later resource-read failures with startup failures. Schema resource updates require a new instance/application-context restart; development context restart recreates the snapshot. Deployed filesystem/image immutability is not asserted.

The dependency flow is packaged static contract resources → constructor-only schema expansion/provider compaction → private final metadata → a fresh defensive copy from every public provider/provenance getter. `GuidedSourceClassifier` uses the same configured startup assembler; compatible constructors may create one snapshot per classifier instance, never per classification. Exact provider structure, `$defs`/`Shape` ordering, canonical UTF-8, hashes and output bytes remain unchanged. No permissions, current source/configuration rows, owner/fence, projections, model results, credentials, catalog or replay policy enter this snapshot. Every request retains its existing current authority, pin comparison, hash/body, budget, clock, SQL and accounting checks; TRACE requirements and deadlines are unchanged.
